// 验收线探针：用 v0.24.0 的真实生产函数（真 service、真 store、真 promote）落一份旧目录，写到 fixtures。
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { describe, it, vi } from "vitest";

let userDataRoot = process.env.V_REL_ROOT as string;
vi.mock("electron", () => ({
  app: { getPath: () => userDataRoot, getAppPath: () => process.cwd() },
  safeStorage: {
    isEncryptionAvailable: () => true,
    encryptString: (value: string) => Buffer.from(value),
    decryptString: (value: Buffer) => value.toString(),
  },
}));

import { readCatalog, upsertModelCatalogVendorApiKey } from "../catalog/catalogStore";
import { ProviderAdapterService } from "./service";
import { defaultCatalog } from "./serviceCatalog";
import { ProviderAdapterStore } from "./store";
import { buildOpenAiCompatibleDraft } from "./builtinOpenAiCompatibleDraft";

const now = "2026-10-20T00:00:00.000Z";
type M = { modelKey: string; labelZh: string; kind: "image" | "video" | "audio" | "text" };

async function connect(name: string, baseUrl: string, models: M[], runId: string) {
  const draft = buildOpenAiCompatibleDraft({ baseUrl, authType: "bearer", providerKind: "openai-compatible", models } as never);
  const adapter = new ProviderAdapterService(new ProviderAdapterStore(path.join(userDataRoot, "provider-adapters.json")), {
    catalog: defaultCatalog,
    schedule: () => {},
    discover: async () => ({ sources: [{ url: `${new URL(baseUrl).origin}/docs`, text: "API reference" }], corpus: "API reference" }),
    resolveLanguageModels: () => [{} as never],
    compile: async () => ({ draft, failures: [] }),
    verify: async ({ mode }: { mode: { taskKind: string } }) => ({ ok: true, taskKind: mode.taskKind }),
    now: () => now,
    id: () => runId,
  } as never);
  const started = await adapter.start({
    vendorName: name, baseUrl, apiKey: "sk-v-relay-fake", authType: "bearer", providerKind: "openai-compatible",
    models,
    certification: { contractDigest: "a".repeat(64), idempotencyKey: `idempotency-${runId}`, remoteIdempotency: "unknown" },
  } as never);
  await adapter.executeRun(started.id);
  await adapter.awaitTerminalWrites();
  adapter.stopWatchdog?.();
  return adapter.getRun(started.id);
}

describe("rel gen", () => {
  it("writes", async () => {
    const run1 = await connect("Relay One", "http://127.0.0.1:39017/v1", (process.env.V_MODELS ? JSON.parse(process.env.V_MODELS) : null) || [
      { modelKey: "gpt-image-2", labelZh: "GPT Image 2", kind: "image" },
      { modelKey: "opaque-image-x", labelZh: "Opaque Image", kind: "image" },
      { modelKey: "veo3.1-fast", labelZh: "Veo 3.1 Fast", kind: "video" },
      { modelKey: "seedance-2", labelZh: "Seedance 2", kind: "video" },
      { modelKey: "opaque-video-x", labelZh: "Opaque Video", kind: "video" },
      { modelKey: "doubao-seedance-2-0-260128", labelZh: "Seedance 2.0", kind: "video" },
    ], "run-rel-1");
    console.log("RUN1", JSON.stringify({ stage: run1?.stage, error: run1?.error, models: run1?.models?.map((m) => [m.modelKey, m.modes.map((x) => [x.taskKind, x.state])]) }));
    const state = readCatalog();
    console.log("VERSION", state.version, "vendors", state.vendors.filter((v) => !v.builtin).map((v) => [v.key, v.enabled]));
    for (const m of state.models.filter((m) => m.vendorKey.includes("relay"))) console.log("MODEL", m.vendorKey, m.modelKey, m.kind, m.enabled, JSON.stringify(Object.keys((m.meta as object) || {})), JSON.stringify((m.meta as Record<string, unknown>).adapter));
    for (const r of state.mappings.filter((m) => m.vendorKey.includes("relay"))) console.log("MAP", r.modelKey, r.taskKind, r.enabled, r.create?.path);
  });
});
